question: Who was Ibn Turka?
proposition: Ibn Turka was a Sufi poet, philosopher and jurist.
reasoning: The reading is the one-line description in her EIr entry on the family member 'Afżal-al-Din Torka' (pdf p.25 n.22).
MK's objection is that it is 'similarly problematic' to Lewisohn's (p.25); he gives no further argument on the page.

MK adds that the EI2 and EIr entries cover three different family members bearing the name Afdal al-Din Turka, so reference-work identification of Ibn Turka is itself unstable (p.37 n.66). MK is a partisan reporter. Confidence records how fully the pages of MK's dissertation let us reconstruct this position and its grounds, not whether it is true.
